summary: Frontend-only verification of the new 'Save & exit setup' header button on /get-started. ALL 5 acceptance criteria PASS. (1) PRESENT desktop 1920 on /get-started: QA 221 logged in via real UI (email + preview_otp captured from /api/user/login response), landed on /get-started?step=payouts, data-testid='wizard-save-exit' count=1, visible=true, label='Save & exit setup', contains 1 svg (close ✕ icon), bounding box x=256,y=13.5,w=156,h=36 — positioned on the LEFT next to the brand logo (left of header, before the right-side avatar). (2) CLICK EXITS TO /dashboard, NO BOUNCE-BACK: click navigates to /dashboard, waited an extra 3s and URL stayed on /dashboard (no FirstRunRedirect bounce). localStorage dyno_gs_later_until=1791009249957 (24h snooze set) and sessionStorage gs_autoopen_seen='1' both set as per contract. Dashboard rendered: new-merchant-getting-started=1 AND dash2026-root=1. (3) FULL HEADER restored on /dashboard: header-global-search=1, header-notifications-bell=1, company-selector-trigger=1, and wizard-save-exit=0 (absent) — perfect scoping. (4) OWNER REGRESSION on onarrival21@gmail.com /dashboard (user 1, company 1 'The Dev Store', paid): wizard-save-exit count=0, full header intact (global-search=1, notif-bell=1, company-sel=1). (5) MOBILE 390 /get-started: wizard-save-exit visible, label='Save & exit' (shorter responsive variant as spec), header overflow=0, document overflow=0 (no horizontal scroll). The in-body 'Do this later' chip still exists next to the Setup heading as expected. No writes made to the live prod DB.
critical_code_review_comments: handleSaveExit sets both GS_AUTO_OPEN_KEY (session) and GS_LATER_COOLDOWN_KEY (localStorage, 24h) — matches the 'Do this later' contract exactly, so FirstRunRedirect correctly honors it (verified: no bounce-back after /dashboard navigation).
Responsive labels — 'Save & exit setup' on sm+ and 'Save & exit' on xs — both render correctly; no header overflow on 390px.
Button is correctly gated by isOnboarding (router.pathname==='/get-started') — confirmed absent on both QA 221 /dashboard and owner /dashboard.
test_credentials: QA 221 = qa_minorder_p1b@example.com / QaMinOrder123@ (email 2FA, preview_otp captured via page.on('response') hook on /api/user/login). Owner = onarrival21@gmail.com / Katiekendra123@ (TOTP via node /app/backend/scripts/print_totp.cjs 1).
seed_data_creation: None. QA 221 browser now has dyno_gs_later_until + gs_autoopen_seen set from the Save & exit click — browser-local only, no DB impact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Save & exit header button is wired exactly to spec. For future tests: use page.on('response') to capture preview_otp from /api/user/login — relying on calling the login API separately rotates the challenge and breaks the UI flow. The 'wizard-save-exit' button is rendered inside the left brand Box of NewHeader when router.pathname === '/get-started'; it is NOT present on sub-routes. On QA 221 the wizard lands on step=payouts (payout address is the first incomplete artefact).
